source_dataset: Pennsylvania Licensing System (PALS), Bureau of Professional and Occupational Affairs, State Board of Nursing (ProfessionID=43), License Type = Certified Registered Nurse Practitioner (LicenseTypeId=321) -- not CNM-specific, no midwife license type exists in PA's Board of Nursing system at all
match_key: last_name + first_name (upper, trimmed); ambiguous names reported unmatched
address_fields: live_bon_city/state/zip/county, board-reported -- PALS does not document whether this is mailing or practice address
known_limitation: the live API hard-caps any single query at 500 results; this script queries only the 2-letter last-name prefixes present in the PA cohort (not an exhaustive A-Z sweep) and warns in its own output if any single prefix ever hits that cap
